name: How to Love
source:
Getting ghosted by your boyfriend sucks. A good-looking stranger paying for your drink, however, sucks a lot lot less. Maybe it's time to break up with your good-for-nothing boyfriend and look for better options - like the one right in front of you!

[from [url=https://violentbunnies.itch.io/how-to-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被男朋友欺负真是太糟糕了。然而，一个长得好看的陌生人为你买酒，就不会那么糟糕了。也许是时候与你一无是处的男朋友分手并寻找更好的选择 - 就像你面前的那个！

[来自[url=https://violentbunnies.itch.io/how-to-love]itch.io[/url]]
